# UX Requirements Quality Checklist: All-Pages UX/UI Polish

**Purpose**: Reviewer-owned "unit tests" for the requirements writing of feature 028 — completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, and coverage of the UX/UI requirements in spec.md and contracts/ui-contracts.md (NOT implementation verification).
**Created**: 2026-10-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [contracts/ui-contracts.md](../contracts/ui-contracts.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are all in-scope surfaces (9 pages, 3 dialogs, shell) enumerated as requirements scope rather than only in the assumptions list? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions + Contracts §U1.1]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is a busy-state requirement specified for every class of action-initiated operation, including form-dialog submit actions (Create Person / Reset Password)? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are field-validation feedback requirements specified for the form dialogs before submit (audit finding: placeholders only)? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §Story 2]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are accessible-name requirements (beyond automation identifiers) specified for the new interactive affordances (retry, clear, re-check, copy)? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-022 vs Contracts §U8.2]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are live-region/announcement requirements specified so transient notifications are perceivable non-visually? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 - Is the "standard interactive target size" quantified (44 units) within a normative requirement rather than only in an assumption? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014 + §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is "brief, self-dismissing" notification lifetime quantified with a duration threshold in the requirements (the ~5 s value lives in data-model.md, not the spec)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006 vs Data-model §Transient notification]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is "degrade gracefully" (FR-016) made testable within the requirement itself by naming which content must remain reachable and at what width threshold (these specifics live in Contracts §U6.2, not the FR)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016 + Contracts §U6.2]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the term "content page" defined exhaustively, including the saved-answer detail page and Login page's status? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is what the retry affordance does (re-runs the failed load) stated normatively, or only implied? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 - Is the Login page's exemption from the shared header treatment explicit in FR-001, given the assumptions list Login among "content pages" while Story 5 grants it busy/error parity only? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001 vs §Assumptions + §Story 5]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is the chat in-stream busy treatment consistent with (or an explicit exception to) the app-wide in-control busy rule? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004 vs §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is the presentation-only boundary (FR-023) consistent with the affordance-wiring exception in the assumptions (notification seam, pending-ask state, clear command, per-download busy, re-check)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-023 vs §Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK014 - Does every measurable outcome (SC-001–SC-012) record an audited baseline so the delta is objective? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are the four clarification decisions (Dashboard header, per-surface pagination, dialog modality, busy idiom) reflected consistently in the FRs and contracts rather than only in the Clarifications log? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §Clarifications vs §FR-001/§FR-004/§FR-025 + Contracts §U2/§U3]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is SC-005's "100% of interactive controls meet the standard interactive target size" consistent with Contracts §U6.1, which scopes the 44-DIP rule to row-level actions while chat copy buttons (36×32) and the send button (40×40) sit outside it? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-005 vs Contracts §U6.1]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK017 - Are keyboard-reachability requirements stated normatively (FR-level) for every new affordance rather than only as an edge-case condition? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §Edge Cases vs Contracts §U8.2]
- [ ] CHK018 - Are recovery requirements beyond load-retry defined for transient failures (download-failure follow-up, re-check failure follow-up)? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-003 + §FR-007 + §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK019 - Does FR-003's "every page whose content loads asynchronously" include the saved-answer detail page — and if not, is the exclusion explicit (Contracts §U2.3 omits it from the retry list)? [Conflict, Spec §FR-003 vs Contracts §U2.3]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are busy/empty/error state-precedence rules (busy wins; last-known-good retained) specified for every async page rather than only the Dashboard's data model? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases + Data-model §Refresh outcome]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK021 - Are performance requirements quantified for auto-scroll in long conversations (10+ exchanges) and for non-blocking notification presentation? [Non-Functional, Spec §SC-006 + §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are light/dark/high-contrast legibility requirements specified per new treatment (header card, status idiom, notifications, in-window dialogs) rather than only as a general clause? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-024]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK023 - Is the cross-feature dependency on the 023 design-system scale (FR-020: spacing resolves to it) stated as a normative reference identifying the owning artifact? [Dependency, Spec §FR-020 + §Dependencies]
- [ ] CHK024 - Is the frozen automation-identifier inventory (Contracts §U8.1) stated as the authoritative source for the FR-022 preservation requirement? [Dependency, Spec §FR-022 + Contracts §U8.1]
- [ ] CHK025 - Is the assumption that the shell's notification presenter is the intended confirmation vehicle validated or recorded as accepted risk? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK026 - Is FR-019's role-aware empty-state requirement explicitly scoped to every page's empty states — including the Dashboard's — given clarification Q1 declared 027 content below the header untouched (the walkthrough flagged the Dashboard gap)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-019 vs §Clarifications Q1]
- [ ] CHK027 - Is the boundary between "spacing/sizing resolves to the documented scale" (FR-020) and shape idioms with no scale token (corner radii, chat bubble max-widths) defined to prevent audit disputes? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-020 + §SC-011]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- This checklist tests the requirements writing, not the implementation: the feature is already implemented and validated (see ../evidence/walkthrough.md); several items above (CHK011, CHK016, CHK019, CHK026) surfaced as genuine spec-level ambiguities during that work — resolving them in the spec text is worthwhile before this feature's requirements are reused as a template
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
